ai.summary: The channel has 94,255 views across 34 videos, but 85,500 of those come from two untagged viral posts (31,000 and 54,500 views), so the movie series themselves are small. Recaps are the strongest format per video, and 10 Cloverfield Lane is the one series that has found an audience. Watch time is weak overall (8.1s average, 1.6% full watch), so the hook and the cliffhanger ending need work.
working: 10 Cloverfield Lane: 4,537 views over 8 recap parts, with part 8 the channel's best recap at 2,355 views
Recap is the best format per video: 363 views per video versus 136 for highlights and 119 for stretch
Highlights hold attention longest: 12.3s average watch versus 5.9s for recaps
Predestination highlight part 4 reached 16.7% full watch, the best retention on the channel
not_working: Overall full watch is 1.6% and average watch is 8.1s, so most viewers leave early
Stretch parts average 119 views per video and 4.6s watch time
Blink Twice stretch parts 4 and 5 got 5 and 8 views, and its recaps averaged 5.4 to 7.8s watch time
Speak No Evil got 172 views from its one recap part, so the mystery-thriller hook does not carry every film
actions: Make the next recap series in the 10 Cloverfield Lane style: a twisty mystery where each part ends on a reveal
Pause new stretch uploads and test recap or highlights on the next film instead
Cut recap parts shorter (165s target, down from 195s) and put the strongest reveal in the first 3 seconds
Post the Halloween-season picks now while horror is trending, and keep one mystery pick in the mix
